cves.title: The UDP implementation in Linux 2.4.x kernels keeps the IP Identification field at 0 for all non-fragmented p…
cves.description: The UDP implementation in Linux 2.4.x kernels keeps the IP Identification field at 0 for all non-fragmented packets, which could allow remote attackers to determine that a target system is running Linux.
